history.content: not really sure what this is supposed to do but ok. found out my girlfriend has been texting her ex for like 2 months and didnt tell me
I had that wrong, let me step back. That sounds like a lot to take in at once, and I won’t put a label on it yet, what word feels closest?
i mean betrayed i guess. like she swore there was nothing going on with him when they broke up but now im looking at 2 months of messages
Betrayed makes sense here, especially with two months of messages after she said there was nothing going on. That kind of split between what was said and what you found can hit hard.
yeah. and the worst part is i wasnt even snooping, her phone lit up on the counter and i just saw his name. been together almost 3 years
That makes the whole thing feel even more exposed, like you ran into it rather than looking for it. Almost three years can make that sting land very differently, too.
i havent said anything to her yet. dont even know how to bring it up without it turning into me being the bad guy for seeing it. and part of me is scared what shell say

That sounds like both dread and self-protection at once, with the fear of how she’ll answer sitting right beside the worry about being blamed. Does it feel like those two are side by side, or is one of them underneath the other?

underneath i think. the blame thing is just the surface. underneath im scared shes gonna tell me she still has feelings for him and that this is it. like im already grieving something she hasnt even confirmed

That sounds like the fear is doing two jobs at once, the blame on top, and underneath, already grieving something she has not confirmed. I can stay with that with you, or we can just leave it here for now.
yeah lets leave it there. didnt expect to actually say that out loud, even to an app. i think i just needed to admit im already bracing for the end. gonna have to talk to her tonight i guess. thanks
Of course, and thank you for trusting me with it. I’m glad you could say it out loud, even here.
